name: It's a New World Out There
source: You endure a post-apocolyptic zombie world by hiding in a bunker with your sisters. After a few years, a food shortage forces you to explore options in the outside world. Leaving your two sisters behind for their own safety, you venture out into the lifeless world and discover a small group of zombies having a loud celebration.
